items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Jeremy Schon & Greg Ormont interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: we’ve been working with this guy Steve Wright at Wright Way Studios for probably ten years now... as far as we’re concerned Steve is our producer

ctx.x: Do you depend on outside ears when you’re doing a recording, especially in the mixing? Do you have a producer or do you just sort of do it yourself?

So we work, we’ve been working with this guy Steve Wright at Wright Way Studios for probably ten years now. And I mean you know he runs the studio, he’s like the lead engineer there. And he’s got an amazing ear. He’ll tell us instantly after taping like, “Oh you were just barely out of tune, do it again.” We spend a lot of time tuning. But he will give us as much feedback as we kind of ask for you know. Often times we’ll be like, “Hey we’re torn between these two songs. Which one do you think would fit this group…
Are you all in the booth when things are mixed?
